summary.text: David Givens is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 9, serving since 2009. The legislature's profile lists Givens as Senate President Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, David P. Givens was born in 1966 and is managing partner of Central Farmers Supply.
The profile lists his graduation as valedictorian of Green County High School in 1985, a B.S. in agriculture from Western Kentucky University in 1989 and an M.A. from the same university in 1997.
It also lists his role as a founding board member of the Green County Agriculture Department.
